{"rationale": "Segment [60] bars the Receiving Party from disclosing Confidential Information or the existence of any dispute to any government agency or regulator without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent; the only carve-out in [34] covers information required by law to be disclosed, not voluntary reports of possible violations, so no exception for such reports exists.", "label": "Entailment", "evidence": [60, 34], "confidence": 0.7}
